findings: Primary arxiv sources located: cs/0302010v1 (Maniatis/Baker), 2103.04519v1 (Agda AAOSL verification), 2308.13836v1 (prefix authentication formalization).

Important local refinement point: IndexedDictionary.pack deduplicates payloads by rightmost occurrence. Repacking an appended source can reorder dictionary slots and rewrite old numeric references; decoded source history can still be an exact prefix. Raw packed-field prefix is therefore not the right generic preservation condition.

Agda paper explicitly proves desired properties modulo an existential hash collision and leaves a full polynomial-time security reduction as future work; do not import an unconditional SHA injectivity claim.

A strict operational history checker should compare complete ordered rows (length plus exact initial segment), then return the suffix witness. JSON equality, Python implementation and cryptographic authentication remain separate refinement premises.
